TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Where are all U.S. Major League baseballs currently manufactured?
expl: Contrary to popular belief, Costa Rica is not just known for soccer; it is also home to a Rawlings factory that manufactures all Major League Baseballs. With a yearly production of 2.4 million balls, they have a lifespan of just one game, and approximately 1,140,000 balls were used by teams in 2020.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which country's soccer team won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
expl: Argentina claimed their third World Cup championship, and Lionel Messi's first, defeating France 4-2 in a penalty shootout after a thrilling match that ended goalless after regulation and extra time in the 2022 World Cup final. Messi scored twice in his last World Cup appearance.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: What professional football team did Donald Trump own in the 1980s?
expl: Before becoming the 45th U.S. President, Donald Trump owned the New Jersey Generals football team in the USFL. He unsuccessfully attempted to merge the USFL with the NFL, leading to an antitrust lawsuit that contributed to the USFL's eventual collapse.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which popular game was banned in New York from 1942 to 1976?
expl: Pinball was once considered a threat to society and prohibited in numerous U.S. cities due to its perceived association with crime and immorality. The ban was enforced until the 1970s when it was ultimately overturned.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: In the game of pool, what solid color is the number 1 ball?
expl: In pool there are solid and striped balls. Solids are fully colored from 1- 8 while stripes run from 9-15 and have a colored band. To find a stripe color add eight to the solid number. For example the one ball is yellow so the nine ball stripe is also yellow.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which NFL head coach led both the Kansas City Chiefs and Philadelphia Eagles to the Super Bowl?
expl: Andy Reid, a seasoned NFL head coach, has led both the Philadelphia Eagles and the Kansas City Chiefs to Super Bowl victories. He could make history by being the first coach to win a Super Bowl against a team he had previously taken to the Super Bowl if the Chiefs defeat the Eagles.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: The Super Bowl trophy is named after which NFL legend?
expl: The Super Bowl champions receive the Vince Lombardi Trophy annually, named after the legendary NFL coach who led the Green Bay Packers to victories in the first two Super Bowls. It was renamed in his honor after his death and is crafted by Tiffany and Co, presented since 1971."

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: What is omitted from a typical triathlon to create a duathlon?
expl: Duathlons, like triathlons, require completing three race legs. However, instead of swimming, duathletes begin with a run, then cycle, and end with another run. This makes it a run-bike-run combination, offering a multisport alternative for those not fond of swimming.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which skateboarder is also known as the Birdman?
expl: Tony Hawk is a legendary skateboarder and entrepreneur who is widely regarded as one of the most influential figures in the history of skateboarding. He earned the nickname "Birdman" due to his ability to fly high and perform aerial tricks on a skateboard.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which country hosted the Winter Olympics in 2022?
expl: The 2022 Winter Olympics were held in Beijing, China. It was the first time that China hosted the Winter Olympics and the second time they hosted the Olympics after the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing.

TEXT_QUESTIONS.que: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cup titles?
expl: Brazil, the only team that has participated in every World Cup, is also the most successful team in the competition, having won five titles and finished second twice. Italy and Germany have four titles each, with Germany having reached more finals than any other team, eight.
